notes: Section Enable toggles fixed: they now show in the section HEADER whether it's open or closed (before, a closed section hid the toggle and it collapsed to a stray white dot), sit left of the chevron without overlapping, and flip on/off without opening the section — so turning Stroke/Shadow/Scrim/Plate/Karaoke on or off is one click. Slider values now use a clean stepper: side ‹ › arrows + a mono number + mouse-wheel (no more tiny native spinners). Right-side sections are now an accordion — opening one (Transcription / Base text / Smart captions, or Stroke/Shadow/etc.) collapses its neighbours, so the open one always fits and nothing gets pushed off-screen or hidden (with a soft open animation + auto-scroll to the top). Keep-together phrases are now editable tablets — ＋ to add (type + Enter), ✕ to remove — and auto-save. Scene cuts now show as clickable chips (🎬 timecodes): click one to jump the playhead there, ✕ to remove — no more hunting for a cut on a long timeline. Save-preset button is now always visible (green) next to the presets.Last caption no longer hangs over the ending — everywhere. The final word's transcriber end (often stretched to the end of the audio) used to freeze the last caption over trailing b-roll / the packshot; three places forced this (build_events, the 'hold last caption to end' in preview, and hold_last in the renderer + the 'exact' server preview). Now the last caption gets a short readable tail (~1.5s) and is trimmed to a scene cut if one was placed before the packshot — preview, exact and render all match. New: invisible caption break — press Enter (or type *) between words to split the caption at that spot; it's invisible in the burned caption and layout-independent, so you can keep punctuation on and still control splits. Replaces the old Manual line breaks toggle; the Punctuation toggle now sits in its place. keep-together phrases now persist across updates (stored next to the shared library / in ~/.assembler, not inside the auto-updated code).
